mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (perphenazine by CYP1A2, 2D6, 3A4; praziquantel by CYP3A4) with potential for competition, and both possess CNS depressant properties.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression and perphenazine efficacy changes; consider dose adjustments if needed and counsel patients on avoiding additional CNS depressants.
